description: Every journal post and build-log entry now unfurls its own orbital share card with title, topic and date; indexes keep the generic brand card.
lead: Shares from different posts were visually identical because every page emitted the same brand card. Detail pages now render a deterministic per-post card while indexes keep the fallback.
